title: The Last Spire Again
author: Felix Dunmore
blurb: Odile Blackwood, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
